Metadata.Goal: 建立由 DomainContextBundle 驱动、每次执行隔离的 depa-orm 领域操作 runtime。
Metadata.Description: 以已归档的完整 preset/request contract 为硬前置；先通过 public dependency/model bridge 硬门，再实现静态 bundle loader、资源分配前 preflight、operation registry、SQLite lifecycle、transaction/capability、observations 和 diagnostics。

TaskSpace.name: add-depa-orm-domain-runtime
TaskSpace.Description: 以 P0 public bridge 为停止门，随后用 tests-first slices 实现 runtime 控制环。

TaskGroup.name: Public dependency 与 model bridge 硬门
TaskGroup.Description: 从 production package 自身证明依赖、import boundary、Kon projection 和 public assemble/write/read 可行。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: runtime package cwd 按 package name 解析全部声明依赖
public bridge smoke compile/write/read/destroy 通过
forbidden import guard 通过；否则停止并 mission replan

Task.name: 创建 production package、依赖解析与 import guard 红测
Task.Description: 创建 ESM/strict/declaration package，声明 contracts workspace dependency 与五个 depa-orm 0.1.0 dependencies，从 root bun install；编写 public-boundary.test.ts，验证 package cwd import resolution，并通过 fixture 证明 halfcode/dist/node_modules/capsule/unallowlisted subpath 会被 guard 拒绝。不得实现 bridge。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 生产依赖由 runtime package 声明且从 package cwd 可解析，不依赖 capsule路径
import guard 覆盖全部 forbidden pattern 与精确 query allowlist
bridge smoke 测试只因尚无实现而红，不因依赖或环境错误失败

Task.name: 实现 public Kon projection 与 query adapter smoke
Task.Description: 仅用允许的 package exports 实现 Kon compilation result 到 root storage-neutral schema/SQLite registration 的字段投影，以及 JSON RuntimeQuery 到 allowlisted query values 的 adapter；真实 initialize/assemble/Writer/Reader/destroy smoke 转绿。不得 cast legacy schema或导入 halfcode。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 只读 Kon source 可显式投影并由 public compose/assemble 接受
public Writer 写入与 Reader query adapter 读回真实行
registry destroy 完成且 import guard/package build 全部通过

TaskGroup.name: Bundle authoring、loader 与 execution lifecycle
TaskGroup.Description: 定义静态 authoring catalog、binding actual capability 与 server projection 分离的无状态 bundle/runtime contract，并实现资源分配前 preflight 和每次执行 fresh create-initialize-seed-destroy 骨架。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: bundle loader 与 lifecycle/isolation focused tests 通过
invalid preset/binding/request preflight 不分配 SQLite、不 seed、不运行 handler

Task.name: 编写 bundle loader 与 lifecycle 隔离红测
Task.Description: 覆盖静态 catalog 与 server projection 分离、完整 preset.request 原样冻结、definition/binding capability compatibility、bundle binding/probe 校验、invalid preflight 无资源分配、无执行状态、deterministic seed、连续/并发隔离，以及 compile/initialize/seed/handler/probe failure 后 destroy-before-return。测试 fixture 定义最小可信 bundle，不实现业务 bundle。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: loader duplicate/unknown ref、完整 preset parity、binding capability subset 和 model source invalid cases 已覆盖
invalid preflight 无 SQLite/seed/handler side effect，连续与并发 fresh database 证据已覆盖
五类 failure cleanup、preset request 不变与后续 fresh execution cases 已覆盖并按预期红测

Task.name: 实现 bundle loader 与 create-initialize-seed-destroy lifecycle
Task.Description: 实现不含 server current projection 的 trusted authoring bundle types、binding actual capability、完整 preset validation/freeze、execution preflight、execution id/local collectors、public model initialize、seed transaction 和 finally destroy；为测试提供受控 lifecycle fault hook，不把连接、server projection 或 mutable execution state 写入 bundle。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: loaded bundle 冻结完整 preset request 和 binding actual capability，且无 server current/DB/transaction/last-response state
exact/preset/catalog/batch/capability preflight 在资源分配前完成；每次 registry/SQLite/seed 独立
连续/并发隔离通过；compile/initialize/seed/handler/probe 失败均在返回前 destroy，后续执行成功

TaskGroup.name: Registry、invocation 与 transaction semantics
TaskGroup.Description: 用 operation.ref registry 和 public transaction 实现 single/selection/batch、atomic/best-effort，以及 definition requestable ∩ binding actual ∩ server current 的 capability gate。

Task.name: 编写 registry 与 transaction semantics 红测
Task.Description: 覆盖 parse/catalog/preset mismatch、unknown ref、selection single、one-definition batch verb/subject 同构、definition/binding/server 三层 capability 逐层拒绝、same-source atomic composed rollback、cross-source preflight reject、homogeneous best-effort partial commit、row mapping required rejection和child tree。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: catalog/registry/selection、mixed batch verb/subject reject 与 homogeneous batch cases 已覆盖且无五维 dispatch switch预期
definition/binding/server capability 逐层失败与 cross-source reject 有 no-allocation/no-seed/no-handler evidence；same-source rollback 有实际执行、整体回滚与 cleanup 证据
homogeneous best-effort item isolation、mapping capability 与 child operation tree cases 已覆盖

Task.name: 实现 operation registry、normalization 与 transaction/capability gate
Task.Description: 复用 contract exact parser 与 preset/catalog match，注入 server current projection并计算 definition/binding/server capability 交集，在任何 SQLite 分配前完成 request/batch/capability preflight，再按 ref dispatch；实现 controlled handler context、single/selection/batch scheduling、same-source public outer transaction、cross-source reject、best-effort isolation和mapping diagnostics。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: unknown/exact/preset/catalog/batch/capability mismatch 在 SQLite allocation、seed 或 handler side effect 前返回结构化 diagnostics
same-source atomic composed rollback且请求 atomicity 不降级
definition/binding/server 交集诚实执行，cross-source atomic handler不运行，homogeneous best-effort batch保留独立key/status
operation tree保留child refs且源码无五维巨大switch

TaskGroup.name: Observations、response 与工程集成
TaskGroup.Description: 把真实 runtime 事实投影为统一 response，并完成 package/root build 与边界验证。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: bun run --filter depa-data-depa-orm-domain-runtime build 通过
public import boundary guard 通过

Task.name: 编写 observations、effects 与 diagnostics 红测
Task.Description: 覆盖 outcome、requested/committed atomicity、mutation summaries、before/after/diff probes、plan/stages、child tree、SQL_TRACE_UNAVAILABLE、BATCH_ITEM_MAPPING_UNAVAILABLE、cleanup diagnostic和JSON roundtrip。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 真实 before/after/diff 与 mutation effects cases 已覆盖
plan/stages/tree 与 unavailable mapping/SQL no-fabrication cases 已覆盖
response JSON roundtrip与cleanup diagnostics cases 已覆盖并按预期红测

Task.name: 实现 response projection、observations 与 build integration
Task.Description: 实现 probe capture/diff、public plan/stage projection、effects/batch mapping、diagnostics与完整 response；接入 root build，运行全 package tests/build、root build和boundary guard。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: response truthfully包含outcome/effects/observations/trace/diagnostics并可JSON roundtrip
SQL/row mapping unavailable时不伪造SQL或item rows
全focused tests、declaration build、root build和boundary guard通过
未修改或依赖depa-orm-capsule、server、UI或业务bundle

cdt:AttractorCheck.note: Fresh rerun found no gaps: pre-admission facts remain nullable and independently preserved; pre-commit failures claim no commit; post-commit atomic and best-effort probe failures retain real commit and mutation facts; focused 29/29 and full contract/runtime 172/172 tests, typechecks, filtered builds, root build, boundaries, and Codument evidence pass.
